## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 104 captures during May 2021. This represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the number of images available for review and the outcomes identified through grading.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.8 per cent. This indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. The ungradable findings should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations and quality review.

## Grading

Grading identified 19 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This provides a summary measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading during May 2021.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Overall, the report records activity at Central Eye Clinic, the associated image quality outcome, and the grading results for the month.
